body:
[Erowid Note: 
The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
Around 11pm me and my best friend (lets call her F) took a capsule of mdma (300mg) each.  While waiting I already was in a happy mood. I really was enjoying the music and I was dancing. After 30 min or so I was feeling my body tingling. It was like my body was getting filled with energy. From that moment I knew de mdma was kicking in.
The feeling was getting better and better. The feeling was so great that I stoped dancing. I was enjoying the music and the lights. All I did was staring around.
Then I saw F tripping. It was her first time and she didnt looked very wel. Her face impression was litteraly (WTH is happening to me). I asked her if she's allright. All she could say was 'I don't know'. Either way, after 30 minutes the bad feeling went gone and she never felt better in her life.
So I was enjoying my trip, music light etc... But around midnight I had my peek. My vision was distorted and I had less balance. But most important of all! I was fealling SOOOO happy :D.
The reall party started for us and all we did was dancing and havind fun. We enjoyed the lights and music. I'm not sure if this is common, but as I said my vision was distorted (not blurred). Like a distortion on tv. The funny part is that my vision was distorted by the music. So we could say I literaly could see the music(beats).
We were sooo happy and in 'love' (love feeling). We were always hugging and dancing close. We couldnt let go of each other. We both knew afterwards that people were watching us and that they were wondering what we took. Some of them even laughed. But on that moment it didnt bother us. We both were in another happy world and all we knew is that it was the best party ever. (and its not that I'm going to see those people ever again)
Around 4am I got my normal vision back and 30minutes later I lost all the effects of the md. F lost her effects around 5-6am.
The comedown was really bad for both of us. We were so enjoying the effects that the comedown made us sad. So we we both went home. And slept all day long.
Negative effects. Our cheeks really hurted and F had bitten her lips open.
Will we take it again? YES !
